exposure: Covid-19 vaccination (Pfizer-BioNTech BNT162b2) during the third trimester of pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women in Israel who gave birth at >24 weeks of gestation between January and April 2021
finding: Covid-19 vaccination during the third trimester of pregnancy was not associated with adverse maternal outcomes and was associated with a decreased risk for neonatal adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Women who received the Covid-19 vaccine had higher rates of elective caesarean deliveries and lower rates of vacuum deliveries.
